criticalPath.currentSprint: FRESH-INVENTORY -> STATUS-HANDOFF (25) is approximately 90 minutes and does not wait for runtime, runner, integration, publication or provider response. Existing checks/fixtures are retained with exact revision limitations.
criticalPath.trial: max(SOURCE-INTEGRATE, FRESH-INVENTORY) -> INGRESS-TRIAL (125), approximately 350 minutes from fan-out. Only an evidenced permission delta adds a dependency. Setup/auth/provider stops and test failures are not estimated away; durations are not limits.
criticalPath.minimality: Inventory does not block coding. Lab checkout safety blocks only lab writing. Source integration needs both actual implementations, not live inventory. Trial needs joined exact source and fresh inventory, not STATUS-HANDOFF. No global presentation/fixture foundation is recreated.
criticalPath.laterRelease: Finite selection -> independently verified initial G1-G4 -> follow-up -> once-only supported stop/resume. Separate-parent comparison needs initial completed bindings, not restart. Final closeout joins recovery/isolation, exact checks, scoped Git delivery and truthful evidence.
